Jeweler Customer Acquisition

CaratBase delivers verified local leads to independent jewellers, estate buyers, and appraisers, connecting you with people ready to sell gold, get appraisals, or buy engagement rings. Start with three free leads and only pay $40 for each accepted lead thereafter.

What you get

  • First 3 leads free
  • $40 per accepted lead thereafter
  • Optional valuation widget for your website at $29/month

Why CaratBase

Our leads are verified and local, ensuring higher conversion rates for your jewelry business. We launch in Atlanta first and are expanding to other metros, giving you early access to a growing market.

FAQ

How are the leads verified? Leads are screened through a proprietary process that confirms intent and contact information before they reach you.

Can I cancel the valuation widget anytime? Yes, the $29/month widget subscription can be cancelled with no penalty at the end of any billing cycle.

Next step: Sign up now to claim your three free leads and start growing your customer base today.
